verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents integrations that route alerts to Slack, PagerDuty, and (implied) email/other tools, and its dashboard supports filtering by project/release/error status, suggesting basic alert routing exists. However, there is no evidence of configurable per-rule thresholds distinguishing new-issue, frequency-spike, or affected-user-count triggers, nor explicit environment-based routing rules. Missing for 10: documented threshold/trigger configuration (new issue vs frequency spike vs affected-user count), explicit environment-based routing rules, and independent confirmation of granular alerting setup.
